## Wave 6 Summary

Wave 6 closes the NCG residuals left by the S101 Wave-5 projector-chain gates and the S101 x696 cross-pillar coincidence workshop. Three items, all GEOMETRIC / NON-PHONONIC, all COMPUTE-class:

- **Item 27** (`CF-S102-X696-FULLCC-RATIO-STABILITY`) is the SINGLE math carry-forward from the S101 x696 workshop (transit×connes, CONVERGED 3 rounds). The workshop CLOSED the ≈6.95 coincidence (`x696_ratio = 6.9556` transit ↔ `1/pairing = 6.94888` NCG, gap 0.0969809%, 20.816× inside the framework regulator floor) as a non-bridge on TWO independent NCG-side legs: (a) functional-class mismatch (first-power quotient of a Dixmier residue and a finite-Frobenius trace — structural, no compute), and (b) regulator-fragility (structural sign fixed, magnitude un-pinned). Item 27 is leg (b)'s confirming computation: re-evaluate the Dixmier numerator `cocycleVal` under the FULL CC-1996 Pauli-Villars subtraction and pin the realized shift in `1/pairing`. **The pre-registered prediction is FAIL-for-bridge** (`Δ = O(2%) ≫ 0.097%`); the gate is run to PIN THE MAGNITUDE of an already-closed coincidence's regulator fragility, NOT to reach PASS. A PASS would OVERTURN the closed-coincidence record (`constraint-mega-matrix.md §XVI.1`) and reopen candidate-I via workshop — it does NOT auto-create a §VII slot.

- **Item 28** (`CF-W5-1`, filed as `S102-AF1-CHAIN-LINK-FAILURE`) is the INTERNAL-NCG derivation distinct from item 27: determine WHICH link of the S83 W1-G2 GV-lift/Heitsch chain the (0,0)-singlet band-0 projector representative fails to reproduce — why the projector-side Provost-Vallée metric trace (`0.04177147`) and the full-Jensen Dixmier CM 2-cocycle (`0.29026480`) are DISTINCT (`pairing_ratio = 0.14390814`) such that Mode-A ABSOLUTE HP¹ normalization is not reproduced (`delta_bdg = 0.85609 ≫ 1e-3`). The S100b pre-enumerated branches decide the verdict.

- **Item 29** (`S102-ANALYTIC-HM-CERTIFICATION`) is the OPTIONAL EVOI Tier-3 re-admission: analytic certification of the NCG-ergodicity criterion (Hilsum-Moscovici Example 6.12.2 ancestor). ANALYTIC route ONLY — the S100b W4-1 INFO already proved the L_max=12 truncation cannot express the HM `t^{-d/2}` regime at d=8, so numeric deep-truncation MUST NOT be pinned (irrep wall p+q≥13). **DROP FIRST under capacity.**

**Carry-forward source**: x696 workshop CF (item 27); S101 W5 WP §Carry-Forward CF-W5-1 (item 28); EVOI §3 11d register-sourced re-admission (item 29).

Wave 7 (transit dynamics; items 30–32) does NOT consume any Wave-6 output — the two waves are independent and may run concurrently. No Wave-6 verdict pattern triggers a Wave-7 action.

**Internal Wave-6 routing** (post-compute, for the session-end synthesizer):

- **Item 27 FAIL** (predicted): the §XVI.1 closed-coincidence record's regulator-fragility leg is CONFIRMED with the magnitude pinned. mack-cosmic-bridge (sole writer) appends the realized Δ + `1/pairing_FULL` to the §XVI.1 record's falsifier line; NO §VII slot is created; the x696 coincidence stays closed. Update `x696_ncg_coincidence_headroom_ratio` provenance comment with the FULL-CC Δ if it refines the 20.816× headroom.
- **Item 27 PASS** (Track A, prior 0.05): the closed-coincidence record REOPENS. Do NOT mint a §VII slot from this gate — escalate to a cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md reopening WORKSHOP (the functional-class-mismatch leg (a) still independently blocks reducibility; a bridge requires overturning BOTH legs). Flag §XVI.1 for re-audit in S103.
- **Item 28 PASS**: CF-W5-1 is closed with a named failing link + a corrected substrate-derived N_pair; the §VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ absolute half becomes evaluable. Carry the corrected chain forward as a candidate Mode-A-ABSOLUTE re-run for S103 (does NOT auto-promote the Level-3 anchor off Mode-B; that is a separate registry gate).
- **Item 28 FAIL/INFO**: the failing link is localized (or both branches ambiguous); the Level-3 anchor stays Mode-B; CF-W5-1 closes as "absolute half evaluator-less, defect localized." No registry disturbance.
- **Item 29 PASS**: the first certified vacuum-sector-structure theorem — route the registry-landing to mack-cosmic-bridge (sole writer); resolve the EVOI §3 11d row.
- **Item 29 FAIL/INFO/DROPPED**: the S100b W4-1 INFO disposition stands; if FAIL, open a deeper-truncation EVOI row (NOT a numeric pin); if DROPPED-under-capacity, the row stays live for S103.
